requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF ice_accretion_likely = true, THEN every required navigation or communication antenna shall have ice_accumulation_prevention_means_present = true.
requirement.requiredInputs: Antenna inventory, ice-accretion applicability, and prevention arrangement
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: For ships operating in areas and during periods where ice accretion is likely to occur, means to prevent the accumulation of ice on antennas required for navigation and communication shall be provided.
